teacher.reviewer_limitations: One-seed exploratory assistant judgments on reused development conversations, not human gold. Arm identities hidden during ratings, but model style may reveal identity; assistant has seen prior controls and edited teacher targets. Plausible independent user facts, refusals and clarifications are allowed. Some adequacy decisions are ambiguous. No human accuracy claim.
teacher.limitation: Assistant inspection, not human gold. Seeds reuse the same conversations; do not count pooled cells as independent conversations.

limitations: Teacher-only best checkpoints all selected at epoch 2 (70 updates), even though runs completed 784 updates. Original-reference CE may favor checkpoints before student adapts to teacher wording. Final-step model outputs were not saved, so this cannot establish that all distillation checkpoints fail.
Teacher targets are 190 assistant-audited Gemma pairs with 29 editorial revisions; not human gold.
Qualitative review is one-seed exploratory assistant judgment on 50 reused development conversations; arm identities may be inferred and adequacy labels are fallible.
No held-out test reads, no default changes, no RL actor updates.
decision: Teacher-only selected checkpoints show no quality gain; mixed is inconclusive (19 vs17 preferences). Do not claim mT5 matched Gemma or rule out distillation/RLHF generally.
